HOW I ENGINEER

Reliability is a design choice.

Automate the repeatable

If an operational task repeats, I look for a safe way to make it deterministic.

Make failure visible

Metrics, logs and useful alerts should make diagnosis faster, not noisier.

Guardrails over prompts

Security boundaries should be enforced by IAM, RBAC and workflow controls.

Git as the source of truth

Infrastructure and delivery changes should be reviewable, reproducible and auditable.
